Miki Otonashi is the client of Annerose Vajra in Witch of Steel Annerose.

What?! Annerose is mean and lewd, but I thought she would be willing to accept my request!
Otonashi Miki


Personality
Miki is a lively girl that tends to act before she thinks. She is rather dimwitted and panics easily, which results in her pulling out weapons and shooting around randomly. Miki seems to have no concept of insults and talks fast and without thinking, which gets her in trouble constantly, and tries to find her brother, risking her live to do so.

Overtime, she starts to trust Tachibana Rikurou and seems to be attracted to him. When under Barde Barde control, she loses all free will and becomes nothing more than a puppet. It isn't clear how many of her actions are the result of fake memories or direct manipulation.

Appearance
She has short red hair, blue eyes, and a noticeable chest.

Wears a sailor uniform, with a black skirt and combat boots.

History
Background
Miki claimed her brother disappeared on a job 6 months ago. She is a Human and still wears her uniform and looks out of place even for Amidahara.

She becomes a client to Annerose's agency, who she hired to find her brother at Aishwarya Lai's suggestion. While she might look like a normal girl, Miki is capable enough defending herself, fighting with a submachine gun that she purchased from a local Yakuza gang before coming to Amidahara. In reality, Miki died many months ago, killed by Barde Barde.

Her brother Otonashi Eiichi hoped to revive her and become part of the werewolf project, as a price to pay. However, Miki was never really revived, and her soul was only put into a magical meat doll. Working as a sleeper agent, unaware and still looking for her brother.

Visual Novels
Barde gave her a "curse/poison", which she would transfer to Rikurou with as a carrier via sex, and lead him to Aishwarya Lai, to take her out for a Philosopher's Stone. As well as separating Mitico Fleuretty, from Annerose Vajra.

Miki first appeared in the bar of the Mustache Slaver, as she asked for the Annerose Detective Agency, people came close to her, and she stated to fire her weapon out of fear. Tachibana Rikurou currently in the bar, got her to calm down and got her into a talk with Annerose Vajra, first Annerose did not want to take Miki as a client but became interested thanks to her witches instinct, as she also heard of the current Werewolf Incident.

Tachibana Rikurou was put in charge of defending Miki at multiple times, and both had been at one time saved by Yamada Taro.

When Miki learned, from Annerose's contact, Elizabeth, that her brother had been transformed into the werewolf, she was at first hesitant if he should be killed but in the end agreed in a talk with Rikurou, that she didn't wish her brother to live as a puppet of Barde. As she and Rikurou were separated with Annerose on their way to the Crimson Tower, to ask Aishwarya Lai about the location of Fürst. Miki then has sex with Tachibana, unknowingly transferring the "curse" as intended. As Tachibana and Annerose were successful and Aishwarya wished to use her ability to read his future, by exchanging fluids, it triggered the curse and left her defenseless to be killed by Barde. Barde took her heart, a Philosopher's Stone and also captured Mitico Fleuretty other important ingredients for the creation of a Otherworld Gate.

Barde also revealed Miki's role, which lost all free will from this moment onward. She escaped together with Barde and remained in this state. When Annerose Vajra and Tachibana Rikurou arrived, the gate was already open and absorbed the souls of her brother Otonashi Eiichi and those the werewolf had taken, in exchange for a stable gate. Miki is taken down by Annerose Vajra, in the hope that her soul could not be taken by the Black Hands reaching out from the portal.

Timeline RPGX
She has been seeking her brother for now 1 year and still hangs around the Annerose Detective Agency. She helps out Akiyama Rinko to find her way in Amidahara and get into contact with Neu Eazlane. It isn't clear if Rikurou exist in that timeline or if she serves Barde. She appears, again, later on, as a guide in front of Amidaharayu and avoids the fate of other guides killed by Belphegor.

Normally she works as a guide for people visiting Amidahara, it isn't clear if she is also a tool of Barde in this timeline.

Additional Material
Follows a bad ending. Miki is killed early by Mitico Fleuretty.
Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Submachine gun

Unskilled Gunman ship: Miki uses a submachine gun, but mostly just sprays bullets around.
Hidden Poison: Her body holds a poison, that is able to paralyze people like Aishe.

Trivia
The fact that she was unaffected by the miasma of Amidahara, was a hint of her supernatural nature.
Even though, she is "somewhat" human, she is more of a walking corpse.
The same machine that is used to extract Mitico Fleuretty power was used on Miki and killed her in the span of six hours.
